context_purpose: A bath operator needs to enforce gender-area and age/tattoo policy for each entry and manage a monthly pass.

norm_violation_today.reason: Keeping a per-person visit log tied to full ID details and reusing it for promotions goes beyond the entry-policy purpose.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Unlinkable entry cannot support promotions, abuse or ban follow-up, or per-member usage limits; the operator is also the issuer, so it saw the ID at issuance.

transmission_check.reason: No known legal duty requires the bath to keep an identity register, so a pass with no identity stored is allowed.

context_purpose: The party chapter must confirm that only its district members vote, once each, in its primary.

norm_violation_today.reason: Volunteers see ID number, address and party affiliation, and a roster listing political opinion is kept, which exceeds what a member-and-single-vote check needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Audit of who voted, dues reconciliation and dispute resolution would be harder without a roster.

transmission_check.reason: Party primary procedures are internal rules, and whether any regulation requires a named roster is not known.

context_purpose: The township land section must confirm that the applicant has indigenous status, which is required for reserved-land use.

norm_violation_today.reason: Local clerks in a small community can browse family and tribe detail in a shared file that the status check does not need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Residence, prior holdings and tribe-specific rules may still require the full record, so only the status part is replaced.

transmission_check.reason: Land administration rules may require specific documents in the case file, and which ones is not known.

context_purpose: A rental platform or agent needs to confirm that a lister owns the property offered, to prevent fraud.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full transcripts expose other holdings, mortgages and ID details beyond the single fact of ownership of this lot.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Mortgage or encumbrance status relevant to a lease would not be shown unless added as a separate claim.

transmission_check.reason: The transcript is a public-register extract the agent chooses to request; nothing known requires the full document.

context_purpose: The temple wants assurance that volunteers working with children have no relevant criminal record.

norm_violation_today.reason: ID copies and full certificates are kept in an office cabinet with no retention policy after a one-time check.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Freshness after issuance is lost, and the temple cannot see non-listed record types if it wanted a broader screen.

transmission_check.reason: The temple is a private body with no known duty to keep the full certificate, so a short-lived yes/no proof can satisfy it.

context_purpose: The bank must release a deceased customer's funds only to the people legally entitled, limiting its own liability.

norm_violation_today.reason: The bank may legitimately need the full heir set to avoid paying out wrongly, so collecting the whole tree may be proportionate.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A single share threshold cannot show that no other heirs exist, which is what discharges the bank's liability.

transmission_check.reason: Banks typically require complete heir documentation or a court-issued certificate, and a threshold claim does not replace it.

context_purpose: A private foundation needs to confirm that an applicant is a member of an indigenous community to award a targeted scholarship.

norm_violation_today.reason: The foundation receives household transcripts and family detail, and the elder learns every scholarship the student pursues.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A community council attestation is not a legal status record and may be disputed, so the foundation may still want the government record.

transmission_check.reason: A private foundation sets its own application requirements and no known law requires the full transcript.

context_purpose: The temple treasurer wants assurance that volunteers handling donation cash have no property-offence record.

norm_violation_today.reason: The full record and ID number are read aloud or copied into a notebook visible to several volunteers who do not need them.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing of note, though reputation-based trust and unreported offences are not captured either way.

transmission_check.reason: The temple is a private body with no known duty to keep the full extract, so a narrower non-membership proof is allowed.
